## Uptime monitor (Task 1 app)
Every 5 min: frontend + API, one at a time.
• 3 tries, 5 s apart, 10 s timeout
• status must be 200 **and** body must look right
• response time per check
• alert on DOWN / reminder every 30 min / RECOVERED / SLOW > 3 s

### Daily 09:00 summary
uptime %, avg / p95 / max response time, failed checks, incidents – from 24 h of stored history
